source: CombatWombat's airfield diagrams, Persian Gulf (page 3027, "Bandar Abbas Intl. (OIKB)"); georeferenced on the ends of 03R/21L. DCS has only 03R/21L as a runway; 03L/21R is a plain taxi line there (left unnamed), joined to the runway only at the ends: A at the 03 end, F1 at the 21 end. Not in DCS: B, C, D, E, F (the links between the two runways and to the parking area); F2/F3 (northern apron) are left out. The chart's frequencies are not used.
